statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum of the set { nums[i] XOR nums[j] | 0 <= i <= j < len(nums) }, where XOR is bitwise exclusive-or on the 31-bit binary representations of the non-negative values. Equivalently: (1) for every i, j with 0 <= i <= j < len(nums), nums[i] XOR nums[j] <= r; and (2) there exist i, j with 0 <= i <= j < len(nums) such that r = nums[i] XOR nums[j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 200000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 2147483647. Here nums[i] denotes the integer value stored in the i-th element of the slice.
